beer_hagolah.he: לשון הרמב"ם בפ"ו מהלכות ת"ת ממימרא דרב יהודה ב"ב ד"ח ע"א וכדמפרש שם בגמ':
beer_hagolah.en: The language of Rambam in chapter 6 of the Laws of Torah Study, based on a statement of Rav Yehudah in Bava Batra 8a, as explained there in the Talmud.

beur_hagra.en: And because they are so. It's a split between Peggy Cho.

pitchei_teshuva.he: ושכר השומרים. עיין בתשובת הרדב"ז ח"ב סי' תשנ"ב:
pitchei_teshuva.en: And the wages of the guards. See Responsa Radbaz, part 2, siman 752.
